data.one_liner: Feather icons port for Flutter rendering icons as SVG with runtime customization.
data.what_it_does: Feather Icons SVG allows Flutter developers to render Feather icons as SVG pictures instead of icon fonts. It enables runtime customization of properties such as stroke width and color. It also supports `FeatherIconTheme` to customize default values for a widget subtree.
use_when: You want to use Feather Icons in your Flutter application rendered as SVGs
You need to customize icon properties like stroke width at runtime
avoid_when: You prefer using standard icon fonts
You need icon sets other than Feather Icons
strengths: Allows runtime customization of stroke width
Uses flutter_svg instead of icon fonts
weaknesses: Not documented for extensive asset customization beyond the provided tools
data.setup_notes: Add the package into your pubspec.yaml using flutter pub add.

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need Font Awesome icons instead of Feather icons.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Lucide icons for your app.

alternatives.name: material_symbols_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want Material Symbols icons instead of Feather icons.
